header.title: Telegram bot
header.subtitle: Your store's command center in Telegram: orders, status, reports, approvals and alerts

setup.title: Connect the bot first
setup.body: Add the bot token and admin chat id in Telegram settings. Saving registers the webhook and publishes the command menu inside Telegram.
setup.webhook_hint: WORKER_SELF_URL must be a public origin for the webhook to work.

links.title: Linked accounts
links.subtitle: Each teammate links their own account with a one-time code — never share the bot token.
links.empty: No linked teammate yet. Generate a link code and send it to them.

generate.title: Generate a link code
generate.subtitle: Pick a teammate, then send them the code or the Telegram link. It expires after the chosen window.
generate.hint: In Telegram: open the link or send /link followed by the code.

config.title: Bot settings
config.subtitle: Global behaviour: quiet hours, digests and scheduled reports.
config.enabled_hint: When disabled, commands and notifications stop.
config.quiet_hint: Non-critical alerts are batched during these hours.

approvals.title: Approval inbox
approvals.subtitle: The same requests that reach Telegram — decide here as well.
approvals.note_placeholder: Decision reason — the requester is notified

events.title: Bot activity log
events.subtitle: Every action taken from Telegram or the approval inbox.
